use: A granary beside the quartermaster, beyond the board.

generator.prompt: A small Roman military granary, a horreum: a raised timber storehouse on short stone piers, with plank walls, a tiled pitched roof with wide eaves, a ventilation slot under the eaves and a wooden loading step at its door. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
